messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands still, then raises both hands to her head to adjust her hair, and lowers her arms back to her sides.","camera":"Static medium-long side profile shot at eye level.","clothing":"Fitted long-sleeved hot-pink top with a dark graphic on the upper arm, a short white pleated skirt, and black lace-up combat boots.","hair_color":"Bright yellow-blonde.","hairstyle":"Short, chin-length bob with a side part.","identity":"A slim young woman with fair skin, shown in profile facing right.","scene":"An outdoor stone dock or pier beside calm water, with a weathered concrete seawall, rocks, wooden pilings, and a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The amusement-pier background was replaced with the reference stone dock environment, including the concrete seawall, rocks, wooden pilings, water, and clear sky. The woman remains in the same side-profile position and performs the same hair-adjusting motion, with similar framing and natural daylight.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the reference image's dock/pier setting while keeping the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the person's facial expression was preserved exactly, since her face is mostly in profile and partly obscured by her hands.
unexpected_changes: The person's apparent scale relative to the new environment looks smaller than in the source, though the camera framing remains similar.
